description: The single asset manifest for the wdu-product-hero fixture. Every runtime asset is listed here; the scene loads no network asset, so a fresh checkout installs, builds, and renders offline.

assets.purpose: Header brand mark, rendered in the server HTML.
Art-directed desktop poster fallback (16:9), composed from the live scene's palette, subject, and accent light (IP-05C pattern).
Art-directed portrait poster fallback (9:16) for tall viewports, per 3d-art-direction's separate-portrait-poster rule (IP-05C pattern).
The one optimized product model (meshopt-compressed GLB), output of the documented inspect/validate/optimize pipeline (scripts/build-model.mjs) and validated by gltf-transform.
